items.title: 18.1 First Row Transition Elements (3d series) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu introduction to the first-row transition elements (PDF 17-19).

blocks.text: Transition metals, jo Periodic Table ke d aur f blocks mein hain, apni zyada kasafat (density), achhi conductivity aur rangeen compounds ke liye mashhoor hain. Lohe ne auzaar se le kar jadeed steel tak sanat ki reerh ki haddi ka kaam kiya; tamba, chandi aur sona arse se sikkon aur zevraat mein use hote aur ab electronics aur daanton ke ilaaj mein zaroori hain kyunke yeh zang nahi khate aur achhe conductor hain. Transition metals is par taqseem hote hain ke un ke bairooni electrons kahan bhar rahe hain: d-block (d orbitals) ya f-block (f orbitals). Yeh chapter d block ki pehli qatar, 3d series, parhta hai.

blocks.title: Transition element
blocks.text: Transition element woh d-block unsar hai jo aik ya zyada mustahkam ions banata hai jin ka d subshell adhoora (kuch bhara) ho.

d block Group 3 se Group 12 tak hai, lekin pehli qatar mein scandium aur zinc ko transition elements nahi gina jata. Zinc sirf aik ion, Zn2+, banata hai jis ka 3d subshell bhara hai: [Ar] 3d10 4s0. Scandium sirf Sc3+ banata hai jis ka 3d subshell khaali hai: [Ar] 3d0 4s0. Kisi ka bhi aisa mustahkam ion nahi jis ka d subshell kuch bhara ho, is liye pehli qatar ke transition elements titanium se copper tak hain.

blocks.prompt: Zinc d-block unsar hai lekin transition element kyun nahi?
blocks.explanation: Is ka wahid ion, Zn2+, ka 3d subshell bhara hai ([Ar] 3d10), is liye is ka koi mustahkam ion adhoore d subshell wala nahi.

items: Transition element: d-block unsar jis ke mustahkam ion ka d subshell adhoora ho.
Pehli qatar: Ti se Cu; Sc (Sc3+, 3d0) aur Zn (Zn2+, 3d10) shamil nahi.
